rule: CH5c-R7 F2: the non-DB inputs of a stored-route compose. F = sha256 over each root resolved for the request's Sites: its canonical path, then every regular file under it as (relative path, size, mtime_ns), sorted; a missing root hashes as absent. Roots are symbolic and resolved at read time from the adapters' root constants (CH5c2-R1 Q6). {site_key} is the lower-case Site code, {site_code} the code as stored.

roots.reason: the Performance gate's newest comparison report (performance_gate, finding_index_gate)
the legacy evidence inventory (evidence_migration._legacy_evidence lists every Site file)
the legacy evidence configuration and mappings (load_site)
the commit store (committed_artifacts) and its root identity (current_store_root)
